text:
maria: Planning to deploy API/SDK v4.2 (minor) to canary at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Canary window 30m, promote at ~10:15 PT if green. Any blockers?
ajay: I'm available to kick off the deploy and watch metrics. I'll run the smoke suite right after canary.
leo: I'll run compatibility checks against internal services and the integration matrix. Ping me ~09:25 PT to start.
simon: Support heads-up: I'll prep a status banner and incident template in case we need to rollback. I'll also be on the support rotation during the window.
devops-bot: Deploy job queued: canary-deploy/v4.2 requested by @ajay -> job id: 78921
ajay: Smoke tests I'll run (quick checklist):
```bash
# generation smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-7b","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":5}'
# embeddings smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
ajay: Pass criteria: 200 OK responses, p50 latency < 500ms, no change in token accounting outputs, embeddings shape/format unchanged.
leo: Reminder: run node/python/ruby SDK nightly compatibility matrix against canary endpoint. Watch for deprecated param warnings.
maria: Notes on compatibility: we removed the old `timeout_ms` override for batch routing; added `timeout_alias` as safe fallback. Migration guide + changelog: https://redwood.example/changelog/v4.2 (please add to release notes).
sara: I'll update the SDK release notes and quickstart snippets with the migration snippet and highlight the alias for backward compatibility.
maria: Rollback plan: if smoke fails or error budget is at risk -> run `deploy-promote --rollback=tag:v4.1-stable`, open rollback ticket in #incidents, and shift traffic back. Keep canary at 5% traffic initially for 15m, then 20% if green.
ajay: I will post timestamps and smoke results in this thread. Will also attach CI logs and metric snapshots.
leo: +1 for the timeline, I'll watch traces and error rates.
simon: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll queue the customer comms (email to enterprise + changelog + status page) just after promote.
maria: Great. Roles: ajay = deploy + smoke, leo = integration checks, sara = docs/release notes, simon = support/comms. If no objections, we'll proceed.
